verdict.rationale: Plaid documents an official remote MCP server that it hosts itself (the Dashboard MCP server), so an agent can connect to it directly. The probe confirms the official MCP docs page exists. Its tools are limited to production diagnostics, Link conversion analytics and usage metrics, and the pack contains no connection or auth setup details. Missing for 10: MCP tools for core API operations (transactions, auth, payments), documented connection/authentication steps for agents, independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can connect an agent via an official MCP server

citations.quote: The Dashboard MCP server is a remote MCP server hosted by Plaid. It provides Production diagnostics and analytics tools, including tools for debugging Items, reviewing Link conversion data, and checking usage metrics.
official MCP server documented at https://plaid.com/docs/resources/mcp/
